name: Gilbert Owuor
biography: Gilbert Owuor is a Kenyan-American actor known for his roles as Bash in Reprisal (TV series) , Maksim in Mute (2018 film), Father Anan in Goliath (TV series), Craig in Calls (TV series), Paul Decker in No Man of God, Minus in True Blood, Ronald in The Newsroom (American TV series), and Malik in Castle (TV series).
